name: pricecloud
description: Plataforma para comparar precios del Cloud

scripts.infra: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d pricecloud-db-01 pricecloud-db-02 pricecloud-api-03 pricecloud-pgadmin
scripts.infra:down: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml down
scripts.infra:reset: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml down -v
scripts.infra:logs: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f pricecloud-db-01 pricecloud-db-02 pricecloud-api-03
scripts.infra:ps: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml ps
scripts.docker:up: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:down: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml down
scripts.docker:logs: dotenv -e .env -- docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f
